newsitem.title: USA: Fleet unit targets insurance, real estate.
newsitem.headline: Fleet unit targets insurance, real estate.

text.p: Fleet Financial Group Inc said Tuesday it established a new unit to provide financial products to insurance companies that invest in commercial real estate.
Fleet said the unit, Commercial Real Estate Insurance Group, will be based in Hartford, Conn.

"With the establishment of this new unit, we expect to quadruple our existing commitments to the insurance industry and its related real estate subsidiaries over the next three years," Kenneth J. Witkin, managing director of Fleet Commercial Real Estate, said in a statement.

Fleet said the unit will offer construction loans, interim loans, permanent loans, secured, unsecured and revolving lines of credit, warehouse revolving lines of credit, letters of credit, and other non-credit services such as treasury, cash management and corporate finance.
Fleet said Barbara. Beaudoin, senior vice president and division manager, has been named head of the new unit.
Fleet Financial Group is a $81.7 billion-asset bank holding company.
